summary: Gorilla Technology Group Inc., a Cayman Islands exempted company, filed a Form 6-K on August 24, 2026, furnishing a press release and unaudited interim financial statements for H1 2026. The release reports revenue of $78.4 million, up 99.3% year-over-year, an IFRS operating loss of $47.2 million (including $25.4 million stock-based compensation), and an increased FY2026 revenue outlook of at least $200 million. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special-situation transaction or event. No deal terms, advisories, or strategic actions are disclosed. The filing is purely informational on financial performance, with the CEO signing the report.
